Ninja students have gathered up to join the game and to become the most powerful warriors. Choose your favourite ninja and lead him to victory!

+ Anime
+ Shinobi look
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: AESTHETIC TEENS
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Do you want to have the coolest and most aesthetic skins? If you want, this skin pack is great for you! Choose your favorite skin now and have the most aesthetic appearance!

+ 24 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Sea School
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
These sea creature teen skins are perfect for roleplay and underwater adventures! Are you ready to life outside the city and under the sea?
* 21 HD underwater high school skins!

items.description:
Are you ready for some awesome and trendy high school city teen skins?
* Great for being cool!

items.title: 1977 Teens
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Are you ready for these awesome 1977 retro city teens? High school will never be the same!
* Perfect skin pack for roleplay!

items.title: Summer Fashion
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
It's time to get rid of the old winter fashion and move onto the new summer trends! Are you a skater or maybe an athlete? Or just simply like the casual, yet cool style? We got you covered! With these colorful and cute skins, you will be the talk of the town in seconds! Go out and enjoy the summer!

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Better Survival
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you ready for an upgraded survival experience? Better Survival adds new mobs such as cyclops, deer, bear, badger & more! Explore the vast revamped vanilla landscape and start your next adventure!

+ 14 new animal and mob additions!
+ Expansive 1500x1500 custom world!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Cute Cats
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay as an adorable cat! Meow!

+ 8 cat skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: School Uniforms!
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
With these prestigious school uniforms, these teens are looking sharp! All that's left to do now is build a boarding school!

- 8 skins!
- Wide variety of skin designs and outfits!

items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs are now in their digital form! With pixel designs and bright neon colors, you'll stand out from any crowd!

- 8 skins!

This set includes the following:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Spider
- Skeleton
- Slime
- Zombie
- Pig
- Drowned

items.title: Gamer Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
You just can't get away from gaming and even want to be the boss in the game? Or maybe even a streamer with a lot of fans? Then choose your optimal style for gaming and feel free to be who you are.

+ 10 different skins
+ Gamers
+ Teens

Created by Mine-North

items.title: SPY Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Attention spy teens! Catch the secret enemies and make the world safe again. You are the secret protector of the free world. You get special missions like being undercover with your friends.

+ Teens
+ 10 skins
+ Spy

Created by Mine-North

items.description:

+ Savannah
+ 10 skins
+ Roleplay

Created by Mine-North

items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
This is the easiest way to find diamonds! Be a hacker and explore a world where you can literally look through the underground to find ores, bases, spawners, caves, lava and a lot more. Have fun mining!

+ X-ray underground
+ Bunker
+ Multiplayer friendly

Created by Mine-North

Perfect for PvP, PvE and fights!

items.title: Parkour Anime
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Do you like parkour and anime? Then this pack is for you! Put on these anime outfits and get ready to take on the toughest parkour. Run and Jump!
Also perfect for PvP, PvE and fights!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 Parkour Anime skins

items.title: Summer Teens

items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Summer days just sitting around but when the sun goes down, make sure you are ready to party! Definitely nothing like those summer nights. Swim around and enjoy the beach! Perfect skins for your beach party!

- 11 skins

items.title: Chromatic Club
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:

- Includes 8 Colorful Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Fruity Friends: Citrus
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Time to pucker up with this sweet and sour mix! From lemon to orange, with everything in-between, these friends will keep you refreshed all summer long!
- 10 unique skins
- by Zombeanie

items.title: Wild West Roleplay
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Blaring sun, blistering heat, and cowboy boots. Minecraft just became the wild west! Can you survive in this lawless land with outlaws and bandits running wild all around town? Roleplay with your friends as you become the town sheriff, the crooked bandit, the rowdy cowboy, and many more!

- 9 skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: PvP Presidents
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Out of the office and onto the battlefield, these presidents are looking for some action! Fight it out as you and your friends find out who is the real PvP president! Which of you will rule supreme?

- 11 skins
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: MFC
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
The ultimate PvP fighting championship, Minecraft Fighting Corp! Pick between 10 fierce fighting warriors built with pure muscle and power! The best, the greatest, the strongest, who's going to win? Who's going to be the last one standing? Who's going to take the championship belt home? You decide!

-10 brawling skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios
